description: The trio range from Detroit and Colombia to China, Scotland, Mongolia and the Caucasus, combining car culture and automotive history with some of the show's largest expeditions.

s03e01.description: Jeremy, Richard and James visit Detroit in three tuned muscle cars, exploring the city's automotive legacy while Jeremy tests the McLaren Senna.

s03e02.description: The trio begin a Colombian expedition to photograph wildlife for Amazon screensavers, using a Jeep Wrangler, Chevrolet Silverado and Fiat Panda 4x4.

s03e03.description: The Colombian wildlife-photography expedition continues through increasingly difficult terrain and encounters as the trio try to complete Amazon's request without improving their fieldcraft.

s03e04.description: Volkswagen Amarok, Ford Ranger and Mercedes X-Class pickups are pushed through a sequence of increasingly absurd development-world scenarios to determine which truck survives best.

s03e05.description: Jeremy tests the Lamborghini Urus on Swedish ice, James drives the Alpine A110 and Richard tells the story of Scottish racing great Jim Clark.

s03e06.description: In Chongqing, the trio argue that imported used European luxury cars can beat new Chinese alternatives, while Richard tests the electric NIO EP9.

s03e07.description: Three undervalued classics tackle Scotland's North Coast 500 as Jeremy, Richard and James investigate whether desirable old cars still exist below collector-car prices.

s03e08.description: Forced into a southwestern US motorhome holiday, the trio quickly abandon standard RVs and build personal replacements whose comforts are considerably more theoretical than advertised.

s03e09.description: Richard tests the Aston Martin V8 Vantage, James explores the cars of the Apollo astronauts and Jeremy subjects the Citroen C3 Aircross to an unusually elaborate practicality test.

s03e10.description: The trio try to make hot hatchbacks appeal to young buyers through stickers, slogans, fake punctures and social-media logic, while the Countach and Testarossa revisit the 1980s.

s03e11.description: The Aston Martin DBS, Bentley Continental GT and BMW M850i cross from Georgia's Black Sea coast toward Azerbaijan's Caspian shore in pursuit of the perfect grand tourer and freshwater fish.

s03e12.description: Jeremy tries modernised Lancias, James recounts the Porsche 917 story and Jeremy and Richard attempt to improve airport travel using motorised luggage.

s03e13.description: Dropped into Mongolia with flat-packed parts, limited food and water, the trio must build a vehicle from scratch and drive it across a huge wilderness to civilisation.

s03e14.description: The presenters trace the history of Britain's mass-market Ford saloons from Cortina to Sierra and Mondeo, ending the tent-era series with an unexpectedly affectionate automotive funeral.
